text:
maddie: Heads-up: I'm pushing a parameter-only change at 23:00 UTC in the 6h change window. No model binary changes — just routing/batching/timeouts. Canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 15m, then full if green. Release notes PR: https://git.internal/r/infer/ops/rel/1234 :rocket:

deploy-bot: :gear: Config deploy request created by @maddie for 1716000000. Mode: parameter-only. Canary: 5% for 900s. Rolling plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

samir: Quick q — should we pin /parse route to the fallback variant during ramp? last deploy showed sensitivity there. Also suggest explicit rollback thresholds (e.g. 5xx > 0.3% or p95 latency +25% vs baseline).

ryan: Agree on thresholds. Observability to watch: `latency.p50`, `latency.p95`, `error.5xx_rate`, `kvcache.evictions`, `per_token_cost`. If any crosses threshold during canary, hold and rollback. Can we add a temporary routing pin for suspect routes?

kevin: The change is tiny: batching.window  -> 6ms (was 4ms), batch_timeout -> 120ms (was 100ms), route_score_weighting slight shift. Snippet:```yaml
routing:
  /parse:
    weighting: 0.82
batching:
  window_ms: 6
  timeout_ms: 120
timeouts:
  tail_ms: 8
```

maddie: Release notes (short):
- Reduce small-batch churn by nudging batching.window to 6ms
- Slightly relax route scoring to favor cheaper variants when latency similar
- No model version changes
Link to full notes: https://docs.internal/releases/rel-1234

ops-oncall: I'll be watching dashboards. I'll hold for 30m after ramp to 100% for manual signoff if anything odd. Paging rules unchanged. :eyes:

deploy-bot: :satellite: Canary started at 5% for rel-1234 (params-only). Started at 1716000000.

ryan: Canary quick pass: p50/p95 stable, 5xx flat. No KV eviction spike. Observing more tail on a small subset but within tolerance.

maddie: OK moving to 25% now. Pausing auto-ramp if anything crosses thresholds.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% enacted.

samir: Noticing a localized p95 spike on /parse from two hosts (eu-west). p95 +40% vs baseline for that route. Suggest pinning /parse to older routing variant `model-route:v3.4.2` until we investigate.

maddie: Hold ramp and apply pin for /parse. Good catch @samir. ops-oncall, please standby while we pin and reassess.

deploy-bot: :pushpin: Route pin applied: /parse -> model-route:v3.4.2. Action by @maddie at 1716000600. Canary ramp frozen at 25%.

kevin: Instead of full rollback, I can revert batching.window only (back to 4ms) which should remove the tailiness. Command I used: `infractl set-param --path batching.window_ms --value 4 --env prod --who kevin` (no restart). Recommend running that first.

maddie: Do it. I'll keep the /parse pin until we confirm.

kevin: Reverted batching.window to 4ms at 1716000780. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: :repeat: Parameter change applied: batching.window_ms=4 by @kevin at 1716000780.

ryan: After revert p95 returned to baseline for /parse hosts. No increase in 5xx. Looks safe to continue ramp.

maddie: Unfreeze ramp and continue to 100% but keep /parse pinned for 1 hour. Updating release notes accordingly.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete for rel-1234 (params-only). Verified checks passed at 1716001200.

ryan: Post-deploy: schedule a focused perf test for /parse, and add a small canary run across eu-west infra to validate the weighting change.

samir: Filing follow-up: make route isolation tests part of preflight for routing-weight changes.

maddie: Thanks all — short retro to capture learnings and add checklist item to release playbook. :white_check_mark:
